creutz_viray.paper: Brendan Creutz and Bianca Viray, Two torsion in the Brauer group of a hyperelliptic curve, arXiv:1403.2924v1
creutz_viray.lemma_4_6: For ell in L1, the map d(ell) is represented by the explicit cocycle xi_ell in H^1(K,J[2]).
creutz_viray.proposition_5_1: The Brauer construction gamma and the cohomological map d have the same image under the Hochschild-Serre edge: h0 o gamma = d in H^1(K,Pic C).
creutz_viray.application_note: For the Kc generic fiber over Kgeom=Qbar(t), the elliptic curve has a Kgeom-rational origin, so Pic^1 is trivial; Kgeom is C1 and Br(Kgeom)=0. Thus the corrected CV Brauer class has Ogg-Shafarevich/torsor image equal to the H^1(Kgeom,E) image of the R3 cocycle.

caldararu.paper: Andrei Căldăraru, Non-fine moduli spaces of sheaves on K3 surfaces
caldararu.theorem_1_2: For a compact nonempty K3 moduli space M of stable sheaves on a K3 X, if alpha in Br(M) is the obstruction to a universal sheaf, Mukai's map restricts to a Hodge isometry T(X) ~= ker(alpha:T(M)->Q/Z). The proof identifies equality of integral lattices, not merely rational Hodge structures.
caldararu.elliptic_torsor_dictionary_sections_1_15: For an elliptic K3 J/S with section, Ogg-Shafarevich identifies Br(J) with the torsor group. For a genus-one elliptic fibration X/S with relative Jacobian J, J is the relative moduli space of rank-1 degree-0 semistable sheaves; the universal-sheaf obstruction alpha equals the Ogg-Shafarevich class alpha_X that classifies X. Consequently T(J_alpha)=ker alpha with the inherited integral intersection pairing.

integral_lattice_check.degree_two_quotient_pairing: Separately, the explicit degree-2 rational quotient X_J2 -> Eprime_Tr ~= Kc scales the pulled-back transcendental pairing by degree 2, so the image T(Kc)(2) has Gram diag(8,16) and determinant 128.
